text: Which Asian economies does the BIS publish a policy rate for?
The codelist has no region grouping, so there is no way to ask for Asia. Trying a key with REF_AREA left out, to see whether a partial key is a wildcard the way SDMX allows.
ANSWERED. Leaving REF_AREA out of the key returned all 38 areas in one request: in Asia, CN HK ID IN JP KR MY PH SA TH, plus AU NZ and others.

FINDING: a partial key acts as a wildcard and nothing says so. This is the single most useful query shape in the server, since it answers 'which countries have this' in one call, and the fetch_data description gives only a fully specified key as its example. Same family as the + syntax: SDMX's own affordances are reachable but undocumented.

FINDING (confirms Q5): the series keys came back as REF_AREA codes with no names, so answering a question about Asia needs 38 codes mapped back through search_codes. The DSD was already downloaded to resolve units.
FIXED. All 39 REF_AREA codes come back named, so the Asian economies read off the response instead of needing 38 lookups. 6076B to 7093B.
